lectures.title: Extra lecture (optional): Extended Globbing in Zsh

cues.en: Let's now have a look at how zsh further extends the globbing capabilities and we can enable them through
the setup command.
And here it's called extended underscore glob.

startup, so you might need to add it for example to your zshrc file.
Please also note that tools like oh my zsh might enable this extended globbing by default already.
In this case you do not need to execute anything.
Once we do this, we are able to use additional so-called qualifiers in a glob.
They are unique to zsh and they are not available in bash.
They allow us to further qualify our globs and we are able to ask for attributes of the files, just
to mention a few of them.
For example, the round bracket dot round bracket close.
